_schema: testId, environment, procedure, expectedResult, observedResult, status, evidenceRef, operatorNotes
note: This container has no /dev/snd and cpal's own device enumeration confirms zero input devices - re-verified this phase (see ../software/automated-regression.json). Every row below requires the real HP EliteBook 830 G6 (or equivalent) with a real microphone/audio interface attached.

records.procedure: Open CIP, call get_pilot_diagnostics (or the diagnostics panel once wired), enumerate audio devices
records.expectedResult: Device detected - the real microphone/interface appears in the list

records.procedure: Select the correct device from the enumerated list
records.expectedResult: Correct device selectable, selection persists in status

records.procedure: Call start_capture with the selected device id
records.expectedResult: Capture starts, is_capturing becomes true, no error

records.procedure: Speak into the microphone and observe input_level
records.expectedResult: Audio frames received - input_level reports a non-zero, moving value

records.procedure: Leave capture running, monitor for 5 minutes
records.expectedResult: Capture continues for 5 minutes with no stream_error

records.procedure: Leave capture running, monitor for 15 minutes
records.expectedResult: Capture continues for 15 minutes with no stream_error

records.procedure: Leave capture running, monitor for 60 minutes
records.expectedResult: Capture continues for 60 minutes with no stream_error
Stop works, is_capturing becomes false, no error

records.procedure: While capturing, physically unplug/disable the microphone
records.expectedResult: Disconnect detected - stream_error is set, is_capturing flips false (record_stream_error path)
records.operatorNotes: The pure logic this depends on (record_stream_error) is Environment A PASS - see ../software/automated-regression.json. Only the real hardware trigger is BLOCKED.

records.procedure: Reconnect the microphone and restart capture
records.expectedResult: Reconnect works - a fresh start_capture succeeds and clears the prior stream_error

records.procedure: Observe the operator-visible status during MIC-09
records.expectedResult: Error is visible to operator (WorkspaceHeader's Audio/Speech row shows the streamError text, not a silent freeze)

records.procedure: After MIC-09's failure, continue using other CIP features (Bible search, presentation, etc.)
records.expectedResult: CIP remains usable after failure - no crash, no frozen UI, other panels keep working
